Master.g1.city_config: Which channels the city actually operates (portal / form / paper / phone) — statute constrains, city chooses.

Master.g4.label: Acknowledgment auto-sent
Master.g4.city_config: Auto-acknowledgment text + send timing; statutory ack window where present, else city default (recommend: same business day).

Master.p3.label: Estimate Data
Master.p3.city_config: Which data points intake must capture to estimate (page count, media, labor class).

Master.dd.city_config: No statutory constraint in this state — city policy.

Master.bv.label: VAGUE → Clarification
Master.bv.city_config: Vagueness screen wording; the reasonably-describes standard is statutory where present.

Master.bn.label: NO RECORD FOUND
Master.bn.city_config: No statutory constraint in this state — city policy.

Master.f2.label: Estimate Review (config: $ threshold +
Master.f2.city_config: Estimate-review $ threshold + reviewer role — pure city policy (recommend: supervisor review over $50).

Clarification.n2.label: Send clarification / assist request
Clarification.n2.city_config: Clarification letter template; TX requires consequences-warning content; OK SB 535 3-element specificity.

Clarification.n3.label: Await requester response
Clarification.n3.city_config: ⚠ config-not-law for most states: response window before close. Statutory: MO 90d · TX 61d. Recommend default 30d.

Clarification.close.label: CLOSE item (withdrawn)
Clarification.close.city_config: Close-as-withdrawn notice; statutory consequence in MO/TX, city policy elsewhere.

Clarification.d4.label: Materially revised?
Clarification.d4.city_config: Materially-revised test (treat as NEW request → new clock, vs. continue) — pure city policy; recommend: new scope = new request.

Estimate-Fee.dreq.label: Estimate required?
Estimate-Fee.dreq.city_config: Estimate-required trigger (statutory where present; else city $ threshold — recommend: estimate when > free allowance).

Estimate-Fee.addt.label: NOT ESTIMABLE YET →
Estimate-Fee.addt.city_config: ⚠ Not-estimable-yet path (prelim search first) — pure city policy on when allowed and its operational target.

Estimate-Fee.frev.label: Estimate Review (config: $ threshold + reviewer:
Estimate-Fee.frev.city_config: Estimate review $ threshold + reviewer role — same knob family as Master.f2.

Estimate-Fee.fcom.label: Send itemized good-faith estimate /
Estimate-Fee.fcom.city_config: Estimate communication template; itemization statutory where fee.estimate_and_notice requires it.

Estimate-Fee.drsp.label: Requester response
Estimate-Fee.drsp.city_config: ⚠ config-not-law: requester response window on the estimate. Recommend default 30d.

Estimate-Fee.optout.label: opt-out / no response
Estimate-Fee.optout.city_config: ⚠ config-not-law: opt-out / no-response handling on the estimate (close vs. hold). Recommend close-as-withdrawn after window.

Estimate-Fee.ddep.label: Deposit / pay before
Estimate-Fee.ddep.city_config: Whether to exercise permissive deposit/advance-payment authority, and at what threshold (statute caps; city elects).

Estimate-Fee.cnp.label: nonpayment (MO 90d · OR 60d ·
Estimate-Fee.cnp.city_config: ⚠ nonpayment close window: statutory MO 90d · OR 60d · TX 60d · MI 45d (deposit); else city default (recommend 60d).

denial.reasons_and_citation_required.summary: If the responsible authority denies access because data is classified, it must inform the requester of the determination orally at the time of the request or in writing as soon after as possible, and cite the specific statutory section, temporary classification, or federal-law provision on which …
denial.reasons_and_citation_required.clock_spec: undefined-soft: "in writing as soon after that time as possible" from the request

Denial.ncomm.city_config: Denial letter template — must satisfy every content element listed for the state.

Denial.ddl.label: Denial deadline?
Denial.ddl.city_config: No statutory constraint in this state — city policy.

classification.record_classification_sch.summary: The classification of data (and thus its accessibility) is determined by the law applicable to the data at the time the request for access is made.

Redaction.r1.city_config: The exemption library content (shared with Denial.nreason); segregability default applies in 25 states.

Redaction.pii.label: MANDATORY / AUTO-REDACT CLASSES
Redaction.pii.city_config: No statutory constraint in this state — city policy.

Redaction.r2.label: Apply redactions — mark visibly / note each
Redaction.r2.city_config: Marking style (visible box + exemption cite per redaction) — statutory content elements where present.

Redaction.d3.label: Legal review needed?
Redaction.d3.city_config: Legal-review escalation trigger for redactions — pure city policy (recommend: any novel exemption or protected-person class).

production.format_and_medium.summary: An entity maintaining public data in a computer storage medium must provide a copy in electronic form if it can reasonably make the copy or have it made.

production.no_duty_to_create_or_convert.summary: The entity is not required to provide data in an electronic format or program different from the one in which it maintains the data.

eligibility.any_person.summary: Any person may inspect and copy public government data upon request to the responsible authority or designee, at reasonable times and places.

eligibility.no_purpose_requirement.summary: The responsible authority must provide access to public data to any person without regard to the nature of that person's interest in the data; no statement of purpose may be required.

eligibility.no_residency_requirement.summary: Access to public government data is available to any person; the statute imposes no residency requirement.

Master.s1.label: Fee-waiver requested
Master.s1.city_config: fee_waiver approval module (v1, DESIGN_fee_waiver_commercial.md): enabled on/off governs the DISCRETIONARY program only — statutory-mandatory waiver categories fire regardless, on verified evidence. mode = intake_review (inline approve/deny) | routed_task {assignee_role, task_name}.

Master.s2.label: Commercial-rate requested
Master.s2.city_config: commercial_rate approval module (v1): same two modes as fee_waiver (intake_review | routed_task). Must decide at INTAKE — commercial classification changes the response clock in NJ (14-bd) and IL (recurrent/commercial track). Classification overriding a self-declaration is always communicated.

Clarification.deny.label: Deny as vague / overbroad
Clarification.deny.note: Deny-as-vague is narrower than reasonably-describes membership: TN·NJ·OH, OK only after SB 535 engagement (diagram legend, v2.2).

Estimate-Fee.dwv.label: Fee waiver
Estimate-Fee.dwv.city_config: Waiver decision point: resolved AFTER estimate computed, BEFORE estimate communicated — a waiver is always decided before any amount is invoiced. Denial is folded into the estimate notice (no separate letter); processing never stops — flows to the requester-response gate.

Estimate-Fee.wrev.label: Review (public-interest / indigent /
Estimate-Fee.wrev.city_config: Review seat per the module mode: intake_review = the intake reviewer already decided; routed_task = designated role + task name. NV precondition: waiver only lawful with an adopted+posted written policy. IL: requester must have stated a specific purpose.

Estimate-Fee.proc.label: No → proceed to work; collect at end
Estimate-Fee.proc.note: Collect-at-end is the default path wherever production is NOT statutorily conditioned on prepayment.

Records-Search.prog.label: BUT extraction/programming of EXISTING

production.no_duty_to_create_or_convert.summary: The entity is not required to provide data in an electronic format or program different from the one in which it maintains the data.

Records-Search.prog.note: Programming-≠-creation loop is TX 552.231 only; the broader no-duty-to-create concept (16 states) is context, not an activator.

data_subject.accuracy_challenge.summary: For a data subject's request about their own data, the responsible authority must comply immediately if possible, or within ten days of the request excluding Saturdays, Sundays and legal holidays if immediate compliance is not possible.
data_subject.accuracy_challenge.clock_spec: ceiling: 10 days (excluding Sat/Sun/legal holidays) from date of request

data_subject.accuracy_challenge.summary: Upon request, an individual must be informed whether they are the subject of stored data on individuals and whether that data is classified as public, private, or confidential.
Upon further request, a data subject must be shown their private or public data and, if desired, informed of its content and meaning.

Upon a data subject's challenge to accuracy or completeness, the responsible authority must within 30 days either correct the data or notify the individual that it has determined the data to be correct.
data_subject.accuracy_challenge.clock_spec: ceiling: 30 days from receipt of the data subject's notification

Disposition.caps.label: REQUESTOR-LEDGER CHECK (class D)
Disposition.caps.note: Requestor-ledger class-D delivery caps (OH) ride on ledger config; see ledger section.

acknowledgment.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

response.initial_decision_window.authority: Minn. Stat. § 13.03, subd. 2; Minn. R. 1205.0300, subp. 3
response.initial_decision_window.summary: The responsible authority must comply with a data request in an appropriate and prompt manner; a response must be provided within a reasonable time.
response.initial_decision_window.clock_spec: undefined-soft: "appropriate and prompt manner" / "reasonable time" from request receipt

extension.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

production.completion_window.summary: If the responsible authority cannot provide copies at the time of request, copies must be supplied as soon as reasonably possible.
production.completion_window.clock_spec: undefined-soft: "as soon as reasonably possible" from request

clarification_response.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

nonpayment_close.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

special_windows.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

suspension.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

ag_referral.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

denial_deadline.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

fee.copy_rate_per_page.summary: For requests of 100 or fewer black-and-white letter/legal-size paper copies, actual costs may not be used; the entity may charge no more than 25 cents per page copied.
When a data subject requests copies of data about themselves, the responsible authority may require payment of the actual costs of making and certifying the copies.
fee.copy_rate_per_page.clock_spec: ceiling: actual cost of making and certifying copies

fee.labor_charge.summary: When copies or electronic transmittal are requested, the responsible authority may require payment of the actual costs of searching for and retrieving the data, including employee time.
fee.labor_charge.clock_spec: ceiling: actual cost (search + retrieval + employee time)

custody.custodian_definition_and_role.summary: Requests are made to, and must be acted on by, the responsible authority or its designee.

custody.records_officer_designation.summary: Each government entity must designate an employee to act as its data practices compliance official to handle questions and problems regarding access to data.

intake.procedures_publication.summary: Each government entity's responsible authority must establish procedures to ensure requests for government data are received and complied with in an appropriate and prompt manner.

classification.presumption_of_openness.summary: All government data is public unless classified by statute, temporary classification, or federal law as not public (nonpublic/protected nonpublic, or, for data on individuals, private or confidential).
